_comment: TEMPLATE — copy to your PROJECT (not the skill), e.g. <project>/schema/metrics.<corpus>.json. The governed layer: friendly metric -> (family, metric) in the facts mart, consumed by the hybrid-retrieval skill's query.py.
_comment_definition: Optional `definition` (a.k.a. provenance): state what the metric measures, what's included/excluded, and whether it is REPORTED (ingested cell) or COMPUTED. Surfaced by query.py --list/--describe and MCP. Required-in-spirit for reported composite metrics (occupancy, AHT, service level) so answerers never silently reconstruct them from primitives.

occupancy_pct.definition: REPORTED by the WFM vendor — do NOT reconstruct from answered×AHT÷staffed-hours (definition includes ACW/hold per vendor; a naive recompute diverges). Reported value is authoritative.

calls_per_customer.definition: DERIVED (governed) = calls / customers at branch grain, computed in the semantic layer (source_file <derived>); not a hand-precomputed cell.
